title: Introspective Knots A #poetryport poem
summary: Poets shout silent introspections at intersections of truth and fiction introduce a projection of perfection that slips on lips of falsehood kissed by perceptions that seduce and let loose sounds inward with souls turned windward Gusts of time beat back stolen voices searching feeling and thought in motion
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Poets shout
     silent
introspections
at intersections
of truth
   and fiction
introduce a
projection of
perfection that
slips on lips
  of falsehood
kissed by
perceptions
   that seduce
and let loose
sounds inward
with
    souls
        turned windward
Gusts of time
beat back stolen
voices searching
feeling and thought
in motion
